cards.text: Jesus has just asked the Pharisees a question they can't answer, and from that day on nobody dares question Him anymore (Matthew 22:46). Now He speaks to the crowds and His disciples about the scribes, teachers of the law, and the Pharisees, a group of religious leaders. He starts by saying they sit in the seat of Moses, Israel's leader.

cards.question: Since the scribes and Pharisees sit in Moses' seat, Jesus tells the crowds and His disciples to ignore everything they teach.

cards.text: Jesus says to practice and observe everything they tell you, BUT don't do what they do. Follow the recipe card, friend, just don't copy the guy holding it.

cards.question: Why does Jesus tell the crowds and His disciples not to do what the scribes and Pharisees do?

answers.text: They do not practice what they preach
They copy the customs of foreigners
They do not keep the Sabbath day

cards.text: Then Jesus paints a picture: they tie up heavy, burdensome loads and lay them on people's shoulders.

cards.question: The scribes and Pharisees lay heavy loads on people's shoulders. How much do they help move them?

answers.text: They will not lift a finger
They carry half of the load
They help only on feast days

cards.question: Jesus says all the deeds of the scribes and Pharisees are done for one purpose. What is it?

answers.text: So the poor will be fed

cards.text: They broaden their phylacteries and lengthen their tassels. Friend, if a taller chef's hat got me noticed, I'd have stretched mine till it scraped the ceiling, and I am NOT proud of that.
Then Jesus starts listing what they love, and friend, this is not a short list. This is a "scroll down, there's more" list.

cards.question: At banquets, the scribes and Pharisees love the places of ___.
Jesus says the scribes and Pharisees love the chief seats in the synagogues.

cards.text: They also love the greetings in the marketplaces and being addressed by the title Rabbi. That's the guy who makes assistant shift lead and has his email signature updated before lunch.

cards.question: Jesus says His listeners are not to be called Rabbi. Why not?

answers.text: They have one Teacher and are all brothers
The title belongs only to the priests
They have not studied long enough yet

cards.question: Jesus says not to call anyone on earth your ___, because you have one in heaven.
Jesus says His listeners are not to be called instructors, because their one Instructor is ___.

cards.text: Then Jesus says who the greatest among His listeners shall be, and friend, I have read this line a HUNDRED times and I still gasp like it's the first time.

cards.question: According to Jesus, who shall be the greatest among His listeners?

answers.text: The one who is your servant
The one with the best seat
The one who teaches the most

cards.question: Jesus says whoever exalts himself will be exalted.

cards.text: Jesus says, "For whoever exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted." That's where this batch comes out of the oven, friend, but keep that apron ON, because Jesus has a whole lot more to say.
